title: BNF on NICE
use: UK prescribing/renal information where accessible. Product SmPCs are identified separately and are not labelled BNF-verified.

title: 2024 CKD guideline · Chapter 4
use: GFR-based adjustment, monitoring, OTC review and medication reconciliation. Does not supply every drug-specific RRT regimen.

title: Kidney News · Pharmacokinetics and Kidney Clearance: A Nephrologist’s Role in Drug Safety and Toxicology
access: Linda Awdishu, August 2024, pages 13–14; reviewed for principles.
use: Explains altered disposition and prescription-dependent dialysis removal; not a comprehensive drug-by-drug dosing formulary.

title: ERA Guidance and ERBP practice documents
access: Directory reviewed; not every linked document has been reviewed.
use: Find topic-specific guidelines, practice documents and journal guidance; individual recommendations require source-level checking.

title: Medication dosing and kidney disease
use: Safety education and reasons for dose review; not a numerical dialysis dosing table.

title: Safe medicine use with CKD
use: Supports shared medicine-safety notes. Drug-specific doses and RRT removal need additional evidence.

title: Blood pressure on dialysis · 2025 guideline
access: Selected Appendix D PK/removal material reviewed for v0.4.
use: Selected ESRF half-lives and modality-specific removal categories; analytes, dialysis methods and source disagreement remain explicit.

title: Antimicrobial dosing in IHD and continuous HD
access: Prescription assumptions and selected drug tables reviewed.
use: IHD assumes high-flux; continuous-HD recommendations assume CVVHD at 2 L/h and residual native GFR <10. Do not apply universally to CRRT/PD/SLED.

title: UK SmPC and US label sources
access: Individual checked documents are linked on each drug.
use: Indication, formulation, renal limits, PK and label removal statements. Local authorisations and renal protocols can differ.

title: Renal Drug Handbook, 5th edition
access: Cited by page number; the original document is not redistributed.
use: No longer used for dose tables. Some pharmacokinetic values still cite it and are being rebuilt from current labels.

title: KDIGO drug-dosing clinical update
role: Foundational principles; read with KDIGO 2024 medication guidance
access: Kidney International 2011; 80:1122–1137. Selected sections reviewed; full-file clinical review not claimed.
use: Cited by page number; the original document is not redistributed.

title: BC Renal common oral antimicrobial dosage adjustments
role: Comparison source; broad indications and older schedules require reconciliation
access: February 2018; approved May 2017 version 1. Selected sections reviewed; full-file clinical review not claimed.
use: Cited by page number; the original document is not redistributed.

title: Nebraska CRRT/PIRRT antimicrobial recommendations
role: CVVHD flow tables and prescription-specific PIRRT recommendations; metadata is not a clinical revision date
access: 2023 filename; PDF created April 2026; no revision date printed. Selected sections reviewed; full-file clinical review not claimed.
use: Cited by page number; the original document is not redistributed.

access: P&T approval April 2026; PDF created August 2026. Selected sections reviewed; full-file clinical review not claimed.
